address: The Glenturret Distillery, The Hosh, Torreglen, Crieff, PH7 4HA, United Kingdom
bio: This intimate restaurant mixes the luxury with the familiar, in both its décor and its dishes. The likes of tattie scones are served alongside Highland Wagyu and caviar, in a room that features both a rustic beamed ceiling and maple leaf Lalique chandeliers. Chef Mark Donald adeptly balances local and global influences in sophisticated, precisely crafted dishes with superb depth of flavour. Set inside The Glenturret Distillery, the restaurant boasts some truly unique aged malts, and they even offer a whisky tasting selection as well as a top-class wine list. Stay overnight to complete the experience....
